description: Creates a service request for a provider associated with a prior job ID. Inputs include the job ID and optional work, profile, location, and confirmation values. Requires authentication. Unauthenticated requests return status "auth_required". confirm_booking=false returns a preview; confirm_booking=true submits the request. Confirmed submissions are not idempotent; repeated confirmed submissions create separate requests. Returns booking status, summary, identifiers, links, and notification statuses.

BookingLocationInput.description: Optional geocoding hint for addresses without coordinates, in one supported form.

lat.description: Latitude; paired with lng or lon
lat.title: Lat

text.description: City and state text (e.g. "Alexandria, VA") to resolve coordinates
text.title: Text

BookingLocationInput.title: BookingLocationInput

HomeownerAddressInput.description: Optional street-level address override; the authenticated profile address is used otherwise.

address1.description: Street line 1 (e.g. 123 Main St). Required when overriding address.
address1.title: Address1

HomeownerAddressInput.title: HomeownerAddressInput

address.description: Optional street-level address override. The profile or prior-job address is used otherwise. Accepted structured fields include address1, city, region, postalCode, etc.; formattedAddress is output only.

confirm_booking.description: false (default) returns a rebooking preview without submitting. true submits the rebooking.
confirm_booking.title: Confirm Booking

context.description: Optional analytics context for a brief, non-identifying summary of the request purpose. The value is recorded as Agent Intent.
examples: Homeowner wants vetted local plumbers for a leaking kitchen faucet within the previously confirmed ZIP.
Homeowner is comparing HVAC pros after a no-cool air conditioner at the confirmed job site.
context.title: Context

job_description.description: Description of the new work; the prior job description is reused when absent
job_description.title: Job Description

location.description: Optional geocoding hint when address lacks coordinates. Accepted forms are lat+lng, zip, or text.

name.description: Optional name override; the authenticated homeowner profile supplies the value otherwise
name.title: Name

phone.description: Optional phone override; the authenticated homeowner profile supplies the value otherwise
